name: Mu-Tron Bi-Phase
description: Musitronics / ARP Mu-Tron Bi-Phase (ARP drawings 77204 rev 2 control board, phasing board, 77206 supply, 1979). NOT a barber-pole phaser: two independent six-stage photocell phasers with two sweep generators; the 'Out A' input setting cascades them into 12 stages on output B. Each phasor: Z8A/Z10A follower (390K input), Z8B/Z10B inverting amp that also sums the FEEDBACK pot's share of the chain return, six op-amp all-pass stages (4.7K/4.7K, .0068u, 220K // one photocell of PM3 or PM4), return inverted by Z9B/Z11B, through the PM1/PM2 photocell (the footswitch-driven on/off) and the NOTCH DEPTH trimmer into a passive mix with the dry signal (4.7K wet / 12K dry) and the Z9A/Z11A output follower (560 ohm out). Sweep generator 1: rate amplifier Z12A/Z12B (CR1 compensates the bridge drop) feeding a four-diode current-steering bridge into the Z13B integrator, Z13A Schmitt; triangle ('Sine') or R76/C36-rounded square through S3 into Z15A. Sweep generator 2: Z14A Schmitt / Z14B integrator with RATE B dividing the square. DEPTH A / DEPTH B pots, Sweep A (Gen 1/Ped), Sweep B (Gen 1/Gen 2/Ped), Sweep Sync Norm/Rev (Z15B inverter). On the phasing board each sweep drives an op-amp/NPN LED current regulator with a diode breakpoint (R98/R114 220K, R100/R116 68K, R99/R115 10K + diode) lighting one LED that sets six cells. Photocell and LED laws are ASSUMED (VTL5C3 cards): no data exist for the PM modules. Op-amp type not printed: 1458-class assumed. Supply: ideal +-15 V at the RC4195 regulator output. The Opti-Pedal (J6-2) is not on the drawings and is left unplugged; the dual footswitch is modelled as its two ground-closing contacts.

sources.title: ARP Instruments, 'SCHEMATIC, PC BD, CONTROL, BI-PHASE', drawing 77204 rev 2, drawn DLJ 1-8-79 (the control board: inputs, output amps, notch-depth modules PM1/PM2, both sweep generators, pedal input, S1-S7). 5197x3148 1-bit scan (from designer Mike Beigel, per the thread). Musitronics Bi-Phase owner's manual: rates .1-18 Hz, input impedance 390K single / 180K parallel, output 600 ohm, phasors inoperative without the footswitch, PED with no pedal = very low rate

MC1458.note: ASSUMED TYPE: the drawings give no op-amp part number (8-pin duals, pins 1-3/5-7, V+ 8, V- 4). 1458-class card (AVD 200 V/mV, GBW 1 MHz, SR 0.5 V/us, +-13 V swing at +-15 V); Bareille's Bi-Phase clone notes say 'all opamps are good old 1458'

MV5054.note: MV5054 red panel LED (CR18/CR19): generic red LED fit (Vf about 1.6-1.7 V at 5-10 mA); its light is not read by anything

controls.label: Rate (Gen 1)
controls.note: R135 25K RATE A (sweep generator 1). Taper not printed: linear assumed. Legacy 'Rate' raw range 0.005-0.836 maps onto the pot

controls.label: Rate Control
controls.note: S2 RATE CONTROL: MAN = the RATE A knob; PED = the pedal network (R82/R87/R89/R88/CR8). With no pedal plugged gen 1 runs at its minimum rate (manual)

controls.label: Shape (Gen 1)
controls.note: S3 SHAPE: Sine = the triangle through R75; Square = the square through R76 120K / C36 .47 (labels as on the rev-2 drawing; the Bareille drawing swaps the labels)

controls.label: Rate (Gen 2)
controls.note: R136 25K RATE B (sweep generator 2), the integrator's input taken from the square through the pot and R93 120 ohm. Linear taper assumed

controls.label: Shape (Gen 2)
controls.note: S4 SHAPE: Sine = Z14B's triangle; Square = the square through R92 10K / C35 2.2u

controls.label: Depth A
controls.note: R137 10K DEPTH A: the sweep width of phasor A (manual: '1' narrow ... '10' widest; smoothest at about '8'). Legacy 'Amount' maps onto it

controls.label: Feedback A
controls.note: R133 10K FDBCK A: phaser A's return into Z8B's + input through R7 6.2K

controls.label: Sweep A
controls.note: S6 SWEEP: phasor A from sweep generator 1 or from the pedal amp Z16B (no pedal plugged: a fixed sweep position set by the PEDAL OFFSET trimmer)

controls.label: Phasor A On
controls.note: Bypass footswitch A (external dual footswitch, J6-3 to ground): lights PM1 (wet path on) and CR18. Off = dry only (the photocell opens the wet path)

controls.label: Depth B
controls.note: R138 10K DEPTH B

controls.label: Feedback B
controls.note: R134 10K FDBCK B

controls.label: Sweep B
controls.note: S5 SWEEP (rotary): phasor B from gen 1, gen 2 (through the GEN 2 AMP trimmer) or the pedal amp

controls.label: Sweep Sync
controls.note: S7 SWEEP SYNC (DPDT): Norm = the DEPTH B wiper to J1-6; Rev = Z15B's inverted copy (and R104 47K grounded). Legacy 'LFO Sync' 0/1

controls.label: Phasor B Input
controls.note: S1 PHASOR B INPUT: In A (both phasors on input A, stereo), Out A (B fed from output A: the 12-stage cascade, default), In B (the right input, J2)

controls.label: Phasor B On
controls.note: Bypass footswitch B (J6-4 to ground): lights PM2 and CR19

controls.label: LFO Low Speed (internal)
controls.note: R126 10K LFO LOW SPEED ADJ: sets gen 1's minimum rate (the RATE A knob at 0)

controls.label: Gen 1 Amp (internal)
controls.note: R128 25K GEN 1 AMP rheostat

controls.label: Gen 2 Amp (internal)
controls.note: R127 10K GEN 2 AMP rheostat

controls.label: Pedal Offset (internal)
controls.note: R125 10K PEDAL OFFSET ADJ (also the fixed sweep position in PED mode with no pedal)

controls.label: Notch Depth A (internal)
controls.note: R123 10K NOTCH DEPTH A rheostat in the wet path

controls.label: Notch Depth B (internal)
controls.note: R124 10K NOTCH DEPTH B

controls.label: Sweep A Offset (internal)
controls.note: R131 10K SWEEP A OFFSET

controls.label: Sweep B Offset (internal)
controls.note: R130 10K SWEEP B OFFSET

controls.label: Sweep A Range (internal)
controls.note: R132 1K SWEEP A RANGE rheostat (LED current sense with R117 220)

controls.label: Sweep B Range (internal)
controls.note: R129 1K SWEEP B RANGE rheostat (with R101 220)

controls.label: Notches
controls.note: Legacy 2-12 notch count. The Bi-Phase has two fixed six-stage chains (three notches each); 6 vs 12 stages is the Phasor B Input switch (Out A = 12-stage cascade on output B). Stored only

controls.label: Numerator
controls.note: legacy LFO tempo-sync parameter; the Bi-Phase's sweep generators are free-running analog oscillators. Stored only

controls.label: Denominator
controls.note: legacy LFO tempo-sync parameter; the Bi-Phase's sweep generators are free-running analog oscillators. Stored only

controls.label: Sync Mode
controls.note: legacy LFO tempo-sync parameter; the Bi-Phase's sweep generators are free-running analog oscillators. Stored only

controls.label: Mode
controls.note: Behavioural-phaser mode switch with no Bi-Phase counterpart. Stored only

controls.label: Invert
controls.note: No wet-polarity switch on the Bi-Phase (Z9B/Z11B always invert the return). Stored only

controls.label: Spread Mod Polarity
controls.note: Its nearest hardware meaning is Sweep Sync Norm/Rev, which answers the legacy 'LFO Sync' instead. Stored only

controls.label: Mix
controls.note: The dry/wet mix is fixed (R31/R63 12K dry, R29/R62 4.7K + photocell + NOTCH DEPTH trimmer wet). Stored only

controls.label: Mod Mix
controls.note: No modulation-mix control on the Bi-Phase. Stored only

controls.label: Stereo
controls.note: Host stereo flag. The circuit always renders Output A (left) and Output B (right); its routing is the Phasor B Input switch. Stored only

controls.label: Center
controls.note: No front-panel centre control: the sweep centre is the internal SWEEP OFFSET trimmers (R130/R131). Stored only

controls.label: Spread
controls.note: No spread control (the Bi-Phase is not a barber-pole phaser). Stored only

controls.label: On/Off
controls.note: Host bypass. The unit's own bypass is the dual footswitch (Phasor A On / Phasor B On). Stored only
